exposure: caesarean hysterectomy combined with hypogastric artery ligation
uterine sparing surgery (stepwise uterine devascularisation with or without hypogastric artery ligation)
compression sutures alone or with IIAL (internal iliac artery ligation)
outcome: maternal morbidity (blood transfusions, ionotropic support, ICU/HDU care, ventilator support, bladder injury)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 36 patients with Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) who had all undergone previous caesarean deliveries, managed at a tertiary care academic medical center in Amritsar.
finding: Hypogastric artery ligation combined with caesarean hysterectomy or stepwise uterine devascularisation resulted in better maternal outcomes, including fewer blood transfusions, less ionotropic support, shorter hospital stays, and reduced maternal morbidity and mortality, especially in planned surgeries for PAS.
mod_finding: Planned caesarean surgery for Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) was associated with better maternal outcomes when combined with specific surgical techniques.
